definitions: To adorn or cover with feathers or a plume.
To preen or clean one's feathers (of a bird).
To congratulate oneself with evident satisfaction.
To rise or spread out in a shape resembling a feather or a cloud of smoke/dust.
examples: The knight would plume his helmet with a magnificent ostrich feather.
The swan began to plume its wings by the lake.
She tends to plume herself on her academic achievements.
Smoke began to plume from the chimney.
